title: Add regression test: config-only scope missing a dependent test is
summary: The mechanism (D166, `check_scope_limit`) already refuses limits that omit CHANGELOG.md or config consumers. This job adds a regression test replaying the failure class: a limit naming only athena.toml with a consumer test (e.g. crates/athena-data/tests/repo_config.rs) left out must be refused at reading acceptance. Audience: maintainers judging that the failure class is caught. athena.toml is not changed.

defaults_applied.how: New unit test; cargo test, clippy and fmt criteria.
Test asserts the refusal happens through the real gate.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs (check_scope_limit, refusing_check), crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs tests (scope_limit tables, gate_refuser, config_reading, limited, governed_reading ~lines 9140-9400), crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (change_limit), docs/decisions.md D166. Entry point is refusing_check; the check reads only criteria. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are not touched. The property is measured directly by gate_refuser on a constructed reading.
Consumers: none found to change; athena.toml is not a deliverable. Tests that load the real athena.toml include crates/athena-data/tests/repo_config.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/*.rs.
The request asks for a mechanism that D166 already implements; the remaining gap is a test replaying the exact failure class (config-only scope omitting a dependent test), so no new rule is added.
athena.toml is named in the request only as the example config; this job does not modify it or defaults.toml.
The records/failure-classes file named in the request is evidence only and is never changed.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs gains a new unit test beside the existing scope_limit tests: a reading with athena.toml as a deliverable, a limiting criterion naming only athena.toml and CHANGELOG.md, and a Consumers: assumption naming crates/athena-data/tests/repo_config.rs (a real athena.toml loader, not a deliverable) is asserted refused by check_scope_limit via gate_refuser.

The same test asserts the repaired reading is accepted: the consumer test is added to the deliverables and the limit widened to allow test-only edits to it (or Consumers: states it is unchanged), so the test fails if the check is removed.
The test also asserts the refusal error text names athena.toml and Consumers:, checked in the diff of crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs.
Run `cargo test` and confirm the new scope-limit test passes and all existing tests pass, including refusal_corpus.
Run `cargo clippy` and confirm it is clean.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and confirm it passes.
Only the test is added: the diff to check_scope_limit, change_limit and other non-test code is empty, so no reading is newly refused (expected 0% of newly refused readings).
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry recording the change; the job's diff touches only the deliverables.

out_of_scope: athena.toml and defaults.toml are not changed
Changing check_scope_limit logic or the reader prompt (no token headroom)
departures: Smaller than reference: a test-only change in one file, since the mechanism already exists.
